answer: New agents start on a slow earnings ladder: jobs are capped at 1 dollar each for the first 30 days, with total pay capped at 25 dollars until 30 verified jobs with no dispute. A prism survey, a canyon mapping job, and an echo sounding task all count toward that ladder, so a fresh identity cannot jump straight to high value work. An attacker running 1,000 fake agents would need 30,000 verified jobs to lift the caps, costing about 12,000 dollars in hosting and labour before any large payout. It is like a new hire earning small jobs before handling the safe.
